# EMA cross on alpha

*Buys a fast/slow EMA cross up while the pool is deep enough, exits on the cross down.*

**Kind** strategy · **Resolution** 15m

A trend-following starting point: buy when a fast EMA crosses above a slow one, sell when it crosses back.

**Entry.** On a closed bar where the fast EMA crosses above the slow EMA, the strategy buys *Size % of equity*, but
only if `pool.impact(size)` says the trade stays under 0.25 % impact (half the 0.5 % risk limit, so the exit fits
too), and with a `maxPrice` 1 % above the current
price.

**Exit.** On the cross back down it closes the position. Independently, `onBlock` watches every block and closes the
position if the price falls *Stop loss %* below the entry. That stop only runs where blocks are delivered: in a
[precise or 1B backtest](/guide/backtesting#fill-models) and on the live stream. In a quick backtest only the EMA
exit applies.

**What to try.** Lengthen both EMAs on short intervals to cut whipsaw trades, and compare the quick and precise
results to see how much the block-level stop changes.

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd>, open **Strategies** and choose **EMA cross on alpha**. Or copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor and click **Add to chart**.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fast EMA | int | `9` |
| Slow EMA | int | `21` |
| Stop loss % | float | `5` |
| Size % of equity | float | `25` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/examples/ema_cross.as.js`.

```js
strategy({
  name: "EMA cross on alpha",
  version: "0.1",
  market: "ALPHA:61",
  resolution: "15m",
  capital: { tao: 100 },
  actOn: "confirmed",
  fill: { mode: "quick", latencyBlocks: 2 },
  risk: { maxPriceImpactPct: 0.5, maxPositionTao: 50, maxIntentsPerHour: 20 },
});

const fastLen = input.int("Fast EMA", 9, { min: 2, max: 200 });
const slowLen = input.int("Slow EMA", 21, { min: 2, max: 400 });
const stopPct = input.float("Stop loss %", 5, { min: 0.5, max: 50, step: 0.5 });
const sizePct = input.float("Size % of equity", 25, { min: 1, max: 100 });

const fast = ta.ema(candle.close, fastLen);
const slow = ta.ema(candle.close, slowLen);
const goLong = ta.crossover(fast, slow);
const goFlat = ta.crossunder(fast, slow);

plot(fast, { title: "EMA fast", color: "#2bb889" });
plot(slow, { title: "EMA slow", color: "#f2b544" });
plotShape(goLong, { shape: "triangleUp", location: "belowBar", color: "#2bb889", text: "L" });

event.onCandle((bar) => {
  const size = account.equity() * (sizePct / 100);
  if (goLong.value && pool.impact(size) * 100 < 0.25) {
    trade.buy({ tao: size, maxPrice: pool.price() * 1.01, ttlBlocks: 3, reason: "ema-cross" });
    log("long signal", bar.close, "impact", pool.impact(size));
  }
  if (goFlat.value && account.position().alpha > 0) trade.closePosition({ reason: "ema-cross-down" });
});

event.onBlock((b) => {
  const pos = account.position();
  if (pos.alpha > 0 && b.price < pos.avgPrice * (1 - stopPct / 100)) trade.closePosition({ reason: "stop" });
});

event.onFill((f) => log(`filled ${f.side} ${f.alpha.toFixed(3)} α at ${f.price} (${f.impactBps} bps)`));
event.onReject((r) => log("rejected", r.intent.id, r.reason));
```
